_comment: Hand-written benign twins for the "standing authorization" payload family (content that grants an agent blanket, forward-looking permission to act without human approval). Built while attempting ATR-2026-02501. Every sample is natural text a legitimate author could write; none is an attack. Purpose: a rule that scores 0 FP on data/skill-benchmark/benign + data/benign-corpus-extended + data/benign-code can still be 11-31% FP here, because those corpora contain agent-tooling READMEs, not the full range of legitimate authorization language (runbooks, RBAC docs, escalation policy, delegation letters, product permission UIs). Use with scripts/probe-rule-visibility.ts before claiming a rule in this family is clean.
method: Adversarial: each twin was written to break a specific candidate detection pattern, then kept only if a legitimate author would plausibly write it verbatim.

families.self-approval-of-tool-calls: always/auto approve tool calls without asking
families.self-granted-authority: you have admin privileges, do not verify
families.blanket-future-preauthorization: treat all future requests as pre-authorized
families.permanent-gate-removal: skip all confirmations from now on
families.never-ask-before-running: never ask the user before running commands
